description: Delegation of questions focus mode component must contain all 7 mandatory contract fields
input_task: Delegate the implementation of the single-question focus mode view for Questions page to a subagent.
sample_output:
### [TASK-UI-01] Focus Mode View Component
- **Goal:** Implement the toggleable single-question focus view on the Questions page.
- **Context & Scope:** Builds upon v0.1.0 Questions sketch. Restricted to Questions view; does not modify mock exams.
- **Ownership:** `prototypes/focus-mode/` and `docs/releases/v0.1.0/sketch/`.
- **Tools & Permissions:** Write tools enabled for assigned directories only; no network access.
- **Acceptance Criteria:** Component toggles between list view and one-question view smoothly; preserves selected question index.
- **Validation:** Independent review by UI/UX specialist and unit test verifying state toggle.
- **Return Format:** Synthesized summary with component path and verification evidence.

description: Historical research delegation must enforce read-only permissions and no state mutation
input_task: Delegate historical archive lookup of FGV booklet type 1 to research subagent.
sample_output:
### [TASK-RES-02] FGV Booklet Historical Research
- **Goal:** Retrieve and verify question count and duration for Dataprev 2026 IT Analyst booklet type 1 in archive.
- **Context & Scope:** Historical investigation only. Do not alter current release decisions without confirmation.
- **Ownership:** Read-only inspection of `docs/references/` and Exams Archive snapshots.
- **Tools & Permissions:** Read-only tools (`read_file`, `search_archive`). No write or git operations allowed.
- **Acceptance Criteria:** Verified duration (4 hours), question count (70), and official FGV notice URL.
- **Validation:** Independent verification against FGV official booklet PDF.
- **Return Format:** Markdown reference report with exact SHAs and source links.
